hands.purpose: Apply one already signed, hash-matching Workshop release while the Hub is stopped without overwriting local modifications silently.
side_effects: write a new public Workshop generation outside the live tree
switch the stopped launcher to the verified generation
preserve local state, backups, logs, exports and user-owned additions
permissions_and_consent: no permission inherited from check or staging

resource_budget.disk_free_minimum: two complete public generations plus archive

hands.failure_and_recovery_behavior: Never modify the running tree. An interrupted build leaves the old generation selected; an interrupted switch must be recoverable from an external launcher receipt.
hands.compatibility_version_contract: Updater and release manifest versions must overlap; migrations must declare forward and rollback compatibility before selection.
hands.verification_contract: Verify every staged file digest, boot a disposable copy, run the public release verification profile, switch only while Hub is stopped, then prove the selected generation boots.
hands.promotion_gate: Passing evidence plus explicit local owner install confirmation. No heartbeat, signature, or review receipt may substitute for that consent.

hands.purpose: Restore exactly one retained complete Workshop generation after a failed or rejected update.
side_effects: switch the stopped launcher to the retained prior generation
retain the rejected generation for diagnosis until explicit cleanup
permissions_and_consent: current-generation digest must match the install receipt
hands.failure_and_recovery_behavior: Refuse rollback on digest drift. An interrupted switch leaves a launcher-readable recovery receipt and never deletes either complete generation.
hands.compatibility_version_contract: Rollback is allowed only to the exact generation recorded immediately before the selected install.
hands.verification_contract: Boot the restored generation locally and confirm its installed-release ledger matches the retained backup receipt.
hands.promotion_gate: Explicit local owner rollback confirmation; never automatic, including after failed post-install verification.
